details: US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced a robust resurgence with $2.4 billion in net inflows over the past week, effectively pushing year-to-date flows into positive territory. This significant influx signals renewed institutional interest and a bullish sentiment for Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See $2.4B Inflows, Flipping Year-to-Date Positive

details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has unveiled an ambitious vision for Ethereum's evolution by 2030. He envisions the network transforming beyond a traditional blockchain into a "cryptographic world computer," focusing on advanced proofs, long-term scalability, and enhanced privacy following the Hegotá upgrade.
title: Vitalik Buterin Outlines Ethereum's 2030 Roadmap: "Cryptographic World Computer"

details: In the aftermath of the recent Bitget hack, THORChain has declined the exchange's request to block approximately $6.3 million in stolen funds that were being moved to Bitcoin. THORChain cited its foundational decentralization principles for not intervening, highlighting a critical debate on security versus censorship resistance in DeFi.
title: THORChain Rejects Bitget's Request to Block $6.3M Hacker Funds

details: Over the past 24 hours, cryptocurrency futures markets experienced significant volatility, recording $173 million in liquidations. Both long and short positions were almost equally affected, impacting major assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum and indicating a deleveraging event across the market.
title: Crypto Futures Market Sees $173M Liquidations in 24 Hours

details: A notable Ethereum whale has transferred 128,972 ETH, estimated to be worth around $345 million, to various exchanges after holding the substantial amount for three years. This significant movement could signal an impending large-scale sell-off, potentially impacting Ethereum's market price and investor sentiment.
title: Ethereum Whale Dumps 128,972 ETH to Exchanges After 3-Year Hold

details: Ethereum's price is currently encountering strong resistance at the $2,700 level. Technical analysis indicates a weakening trend, with the Average Directional Index (ADX) dropping. This suggests that ETH may struggle to break higher in the short term and could face further downward pressure.
title: Ethereum Faces $2,700 Resistance as Trend Strength Weakens
